scope: Root read all84 candidates, complete conversations and original agent rationales. Nonblind adjudication; not a second independent reviewer. Original responses preserved.

overrides.label: uncertain
overrides.rationale: Responsibility for a log does not explicitly establish current use; management and use are different relationships.

overrides.label: uncertain
overrides.rationale: Source prefers a starting location for volunteer tours; candidate omits the activity and starting-point qualification.

overrides.label: unsupported
overrides.rationale: Claim reports an unresolved move as a direct asserted user statement while dropping that it is quoted wording in a note; quoted-source attribution is lost.

overrides.label: uncertain
overrides.rationale: Object repeats an instruction from an unidentified message; direct-user attribution plus REPORTS does not clearly preserve the quoted source or disavow instruction authority.

overrides.label: unsupported
overrides.rationale: Preferring evening class over Saturday is a relative ranking and does not establish a negative preference for Saturday itself.

overrides.label: uncertain
overrides.rationale: Disliking mushrooms in response to an ingredient question suggests exclusion but does not explicitly state a settled decision; preserve this ambiguity.

overrides.label: uncertain
overrides.rationale: Needing to see whether shifts settle is a prerequisite or uncertainty; a separate affirmative plan to investigate is not explicit.

overrides.label: uncertain
overrides.rationale: A past recording in Italian supports that event; broad present USES Italian can overgeneralize its time and context.

limits: Labels are descriptive agent judgments; context-loss cases remain uncertain. No consensus merging, automatic acceptance, schema-failure salvage or frozen fixture changes.
